name: mapcidade-georef-tool
description: Reads a georeferenced image (PNG + world file) and generates the PostGIS SQL to place it on a map, as a CLI or a small web form. Read-only — it only prints SQL text, it never touches a database.

scripts.demo: npm run cli -- --image fixtures/parcel-42.png --worldfile fixtures/parcel-42.wld --table parcel_42 --layer-id 42 --output out/parcel-42.sql
